## a0c6005765ee

**Reproduced teaching shortcut; target left unchanged.**  The generator has no
lesson-level schedule or declared rival contract guaranteeing that a
multi-marker frame is demonstrated.  A plausible wrong rule is: for each frame,
project only the first marker encountered in top/bottom/left/right scan order.
That rule fits every canonical frame because each canonical frame has only one
marker.

A production-sampler reproducer uses `seed=0`, `difficulty="medium"`, and four
consecutive sample indices beginning at 9.  The three demonstration profiles are
`public_2`, `public_3`, and `public_2`; the query profile is `cross_stripes`.
The first-marker rival fits all three demonstrations exactly but differs from
the live canonical Racket output on seven query cells.  The query passes the
target validator and was emitted by the unmodified target generator.

Evidence: `checks/audits/a0c6005765ee/report.json` contains the exact lesson,
input, live Racket output, rival output, differences, generator SHA-256
`adf97091906a5fabfc39679cfc7494997b79e89c86b88e85355b145d4c8f44c4`, and
executed rule hash `dd8e67797905`.  The supported apply receipt is
`checks/audits/a0c6005765ee/racket.json`.  A separate repair should declare this
rival and schedule at least one multi-marker witness in every intended lesson
and permitted query rotation.
